from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(description="Full name of the party as written in the text")
    role: str = Field(description="Party role (e.g., Appellant, Appellee, Respondent)")

class Court(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(description="Full court name as written in the text")
    level: str = Field(description="Instance level (e.g., First Instance, Second Instance)")

class CaseNumber(BaseModel):
    number: str = Field(description="Full case number as written")
    type: str = Field(description="Type of case number (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Execution)")

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    amount: float = Field(description="Numerical value of the amount")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency or unit, e.g., 'Yuan'")
    payer: str = Field(description="Who bears the cost or liability")
    item_type: str = Field(description="Description of the item (e.g., Appeal Fee, Fine)")

class VerdictClause(BaseModel):
    content: str = Field(description="Key text of the ruling order or reason")
    action: str = Field(description="The specific action taken (e.g., Maintain, Revoke, Dismiss)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    parties: List[Party] = Field(description="List of all parties in the document")
    courts: List[Court] = Field(description="List of all courts mentioned")
    case_numbers: List[CaseNumber] = Field(description="List of all case numbers found")
    financial_items: List[FinancialItem] = Field(description="List of all monetary amounts and fees")
    verdict_clauses: List[VerdictClause] = Field(description="List of key ruling actions and details")
    case_types: List[str] = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")
